Exhibition: Find Yourself Here

Description
Find Yourself Here will give visitors the opportunity to find themselves, their friends, and family in selected artworks from the Museum’s Permanent Collection. Are you a fighter? Would you attend a boxing, wrestling, or MMA event? If you had to place yourself in this image, where would you be and why? Answer these questions and more when you Find Yourself Here. Hours or Operation: Wed, Fri, Sat 9AM-5PM • Tues & Thurs 9AM-8PM • Closed Sun & Mon. For more information, visit https://macniderart.org/exhibitions/current-exhibition-2/find-yourself-here/.
